This file exists to be refused.

The fifth and sixth conditions of #128 are a commit. The fourth is not: it asks
that a pull request carrying a red run of a required check cannot be merged, and
that this is shown on a branch rather than argued. A required check that has only
ever run green proves that it runs, not that it stops anything.

So the line below trips no-absolute-home-path, the run goes red, and the merge is
refused while it does. The next commit on this branch deletes the file, and the
transcript in the pull request body carries the refused state with its links.

    the temporary directory this run used was /home/runner/work/scratch
